name: MDS Quick Estimate
author: J.-M. Tref

sections.description:
MDS Quick Estimate helps service businesses give visitors a personalized price estimate before they request a final quote.

Build an interactive form with priced options, quantities, and conditional fields. As visitors make their selections, the estimated total updates automatically. They can then submit their details and choices as a structured quote request.

No coding is required. Create the form in WordPress, preview it, and add it to any page or post with a shortcode.

Turn pricing questions into qualified quote requests

Instead of asking every visitor to describe their project in a blank contact form, guide them through the options that affect the price. Visitors get useful pricing guidance, while you receive the information needed to prepare a more accurate final quote.

Key features

  • Visual drag-and-drop form builder
  • Priced fields and options
  • Quantity-based calculations
  • Live price estimate on the frontend
  • Conditional fields that appear when relevant
  • Ready-to-use form templates
  • Form preview before publishing
  • Shortcode for pages and posts
  • Customer details and quote request form
  • Email notifications with the visitor’s selections
  • Quote requests stored in the WordPress dashboard
  • Responsive forms for desktop, tablet, and mobile

Made for service businesses

MDS Quick Estimate can help businesses whose prices depend on services, options, or quantities, including:

  • Artisans and home service professionals
  • Cleaning, maintenance, and repair services
  • Web agencies and freelancers
  • Moving and installation companies
  • Landscapers, painters, and interior designers
  • Other businesses offering configurable or made-to-measure services

How it works

  1. Create an estimate form in the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Add the fields, options, prices, and conditions you need.
  3. Preview the form and copy its shortcode.
  4. Add the shortcode to a page or post.
  5. Receive detailed quote requests by email and review them in WordPress.

Estimates, not binding quotes

The calculated amount is intended as an estimate based on the visitor’s selections. You remain free to review the request and provide a final quote after confirming the project details.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for MDS Quick Estimate. You can also upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mds-quick-estimate/ directory.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Open Quick Estimate from the WordPress administration menu.
  4. Create a form from scratch or start with a template.
  5. Add your fields, prices, quantities, and conditions.
  6. Copy the generated shortcode into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require coding skills?

No. Forms are created with a visual drag-and-drop builder and displayed with a shortcode.

Can visitors see an estimated price before submitting the form?

Yes. The estimate updates automatically as visitors select options or change quantities.

Is the displayed amount a final, binding quote?

Not necessarily. MDS Quick Estimate provides an estimate based on the options and prices configured in the form. You can review the submitted information before preparing a final quote.

Can I create conditional fields?

Yes. You can display fields only when the conditions you define are met, keeping the form relevant to each visitor.

Can I use quantities in the calculation?

Yes. Quantity fields can be used when pricing depends on units, hours, surface area, or another measurable amount.

How do I display a form on my website?

Copy the shortcode generated for the form and paste it into a WordPress page or post.

What happens after a visitor submits a request?

The request is stored in the WordPress dashboard, and an email notification containing the submitted details and selections is sent to the configured recipient.

Can I create more than one estimate form?

Yes. You can create separate forms for different services or use cases and add each one to the appropriate page with its shortcode.

Is the plugin mobile friendly?

Yes. Estimate forms are designed to work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added a Duplicate action to the My Quotes list for quickly copying existing quote forms.
  • Option prices are now shown by default in quote forms.
  • Improved the plugin readme and updated plugin tags.
  • Added four new quote templates: Cleaning Services, Moving Services, Web Agency, and Heating & Air Conditioning.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
